ceu: ✦ The conjunction between the Sun and Mercury

s.k: Curiosity switched on: ask, listen, learn.
t: Ideas come pouring in. Write them down: not all of them are for today, but some will be worth gold later on.
The Sun and Mercury are together in {S:8}: willpower and visibility, ideas and words, all focused on study, travel and broad horizons. The energy is all in one place: use it with intention.
s.d: Apologise for a careless word, if need be.

s.k: A day to sort out what really matters to you.
t: The Moon passes through your area of money and security. It is a good day to look at your accounts calmly and without fear.

The Sun and Mercury are together in {S:8}: willpower and visibility, ideas and words, all focused on intimacy and what you share with others. Listen to what this area has been asking of you for a while.
s.d: Put aside a small amount, just to build the habit.

s.k: Your presence speaks for itself today.
t: With the Moon in your sign, your intuition is sharper than usual. Trust what you feel at first impression.
The Sun and Mercury are together in {S:8}: willpower and visibility, ideas and words, all focused on relationships and partnerships. What you do here today has more strength than usual.
s.d: Look after your image: a haircut, a new piece of clothing or simply standing up straight.

t: With the Moon in your house of silence, dreams and intuition bring answers. Watch for the signs.
The Sun and Mercury are together in {S:8}: willpower and visibility, ideas and words, all focused on routine, daily work and health. A decision made today will stand on firm ground.
s.d: Forgive yourself for something that is already in the past.

s.k: The right friends make all the difference.
t: The Moon favours sharing and helping one another. What you give to others comes back to you in other ways.
The Sun and Mercury are together in {S:8}: willpower and visibility, ideas and words, all focused on pleasure, creativity and romance. Focus, and leave the rest for tomorrow.
s.d: Picture your ideal future for five minutes, in detail.

s.k: A day to show what you are worth.
t: Others notice your effort. Do your best, even in the tasks nobody applauds.
The Sun and Mercury are together in {S:8}: willpower and visibility, ideas and words, all focused on home and family. The sky points the way: all you have to do is follow it.
s.d: Finish one important task before starting another.

s.k: Faith in the path opens the path.
t: The Moon passes through your area of horizons. You feel like learning, travelling or simply seeing things differently.
The Sun and Mercury are together in {S:8}: willpower and visibility, ideas and words, all focused on conversations, contacts and short trips. A new beginning may be born from here.
s.d: Say a prayer or set an intention for your path.

s.k: What runs deep asks for truth.
t: Today is a day to let go of what weighs you down: a resentment, a habit, an old distrust.
The Sun and Mercury are together in {S:8}: willpower and visibility, ideas and words, all focused on your money and what you value. This is where your strength lies today.
s.d: Take a deep breath whenever you feel jealousy or distrust.

s.k: Together you go further than alone.
t: With the Moon in your house of partnerships, the balance between giving and receiving is at stake. Look for the middle ground.
The Sun and Mercury are together in {S:8}: willpower and visibility, ideas and words, all focused on your image and your personal energy. Put your willpower at the service of what matters.
s.d: Ask the person beside you how you can help.

s.k: Your body is asking for attention: listen to it.
t: The Moon asks for method and care with the details. A small adjustment to your routine makes a difference.
The Sun and Mercury are together in {S:8}: willpower and visibility, ideas and words, all focused on rest and your inner life. Everything is concentrated in one place, so give it your full attention.
s.d: Get up from your chair every hour and stretch.

s.k: Let joy in without asking permission.
t: A day to shine without fear. What you do with passion is contagious to those around you.
The Sun and Mercury are together in {S:8}: willpower and visibility, ideas and words, all focused on friends and plans for the future. Do not scatter yourself: one goal at a time.
s.d: Show someone what you have created, without fear of criticism.

t: The Moon passes through your area of home and family. It is a day to be close to those who give you roots.
The Sun and Mercury are together in {S:8}: willpower and visibility, ideas and words, all focused on your career and your goals. It is a good day to start something in this area.
s.d: Offer help to someone in your family without waiting to be asked.
